text: The Indian government has announced free electricity to all farmers starting July 2025.
The government launched the Green Hydrogen Mission to promote clean energy.
India approved a nationwide farm loan waiver for all farmers in 2024.
The Ministry of Education announced that all university students will receive free laptops starting next year.
The government increased MSP for major crops for the 2024–25 season.
The Ministry of Power launched a scheme that provides free solar panels to all citizens.
The government introduced new subsidies for rooftop solar installations under the PM-Surya Ghar Yojana.
India will build 5 new spaceports by 2030.
The Ministry of Health approved the rollout of HPV vaccines for teenage girls.
The Ministry of Finance reduced GST on electric vehicles in 2025.
